name: smwpatches-numerical-dragon-coin-counter
title: Numerical Dragon Coin Counter
description:
Displays Dragon Coins as a number rather than displaying each coin.
NOTE: If you don't want the "x" and the number to use palette 8, use Smallhacker's Status Bar editor to change it to palette 7.

Feel free to add this to the patch and resubmit it or PM me on how to do it.
